_about: Public-domain John Frederick Schroeder (1800-1857), Episcopal minister of Trinity Church, New York, for the Word Hoard: The Great Man in Israel (on Bishop Hobart), a plea for the industrious poor, The Intellectual and Moral Resources of Horticulture, and the memoir of Mary Anna Boardman. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 110 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

D., delivered in Trinity Church, and St. Paul's and St. John's Chapels, in the city of New-York, September, A.D. MDCCCXXX [1830] (New-York : Printed at the Protestant Episcopal Press, 1830)
